name: Mocha Maid
source: In Mocha Maid you'll follow the life of Haru, a boy who just wants to live as quietly as possible, but with no money after being fired he gets the opportunity to open a business with an old stranger, together with his friend Asuka he starts Mocha Maid, a Maid Café that they plan to make the biggest in town, but Haru also wants to corrupt his maids for his own personal desire, why does he have this kind of desire? come play and find out​
translation: 在《摩卡女仆》中，你将跟随哈鲁的一生，一个只想尽可能安静地生活的男孩，但被解雇后身无分文的他得到了和一个老陌生人一起开店的机会，和他的朋友明日香一起创办了摩卡女仆咖啡馆，他们计划将其打造为镇上最大的女仆咖啡馆，但哈鲁也想为了自己的私欲而腐蚀他的女仆，为什么他会有这种欲望呢？来玩看看吧​
